reviews.title: Requesting new feature
reviews.text: Improve the reading mode like classic book reading (side by side) and make it editable and editing it and taking notes in this style. Also the most important thing to be previewing Right to Left for Arabic books.

reviews.title: NEW Page and Note limit
reviews.text:
I’m extremely sad that this app has become essentially unusable with this page limit. I have a question for the devs and more importantly the shareholders—I understand this is what the higher ups wanted, but what exactly is any student supposed to do with 10 pages? There’s very little notice or warning of the page limit, especially for those of us who have used the app since before the change. I understand storage space, but I don’t get why it couldn’t be a cumulative storage instead of 10 pages per notebook. I would have likely paid for premium if it felt fair, but those 10 pages doesn’t even get most of us through the semester. I get every customizable option being behind a paywall, but one of the key features? To take notes? 

The only reason this isn’t getting 1 star is because this app got me through my first year and a half of college. But I’m tired of companies taking away features that brought me to their product, then taking it away to make me pay for it. So sad.

reviews.title: Yet another app ruined by "premium" features
reviews.text: I understand the need financially for a subscription option. But there are clear lines (to anyone with common sense) between what is reasonable to put behind a paywall and what is not. Paying to use more than 10 pages is simply ludicrous. It is a notes app! To write notes! For which you need pages! If you truly need the funds, make the app a one time purchase from the App Store and stop with this greedy subscription nonsense that consumers are getting sick of. I used to use this app a lot but I obviously will be using another.

reviews.title: Been using for over a year but gotten glitchier over time
reviews.text: I purchased premium because I really liked this app and have been using it for vet school. However, it is extremely buggy. Sometimes it will turn off the music I am playing through apple music if I start writing or even open one of my notes pages. Also, it will sometimes jumble up my writing on notes, and looks like things have shifted all around. Usually, exiting the app and re-entering will fix it, but this time, I have an extremely important notes page that has stayed jumbled after multiple times of exiting the app. Also, I hate that you can’t use all of the sticker packs on home Wifis, and I have no idea why it would be that way. On school wifi or other public wifis like the bookstore, all sticker packs are available, but not on home wifi (and even verified at a friend’s house with their wifi). That is so weird!!!!! I can’t emphasize enough that this app completely screwed up one of my notes and has stayed all jumbled up. Text all jumbled, moved around, etc. Terrible terrible app. I am extremely frustrated and angry. It seems difficult and annoying to reach support. This app has failed me greatly.

reviews.title: User for 3+ years — disappointed.
reviews.text: For the first 2+ years, the app was so perfect that I even bought Premium. Since this August, I’ve been having issues. I use this app to take notes for all of my college courses, so I’ve had at least 25 course folders with dozens of notes in here alongside personal notes. Recently, the app began to go haywire. I would get this really weird error message during audio recording that forced me to close the app, and my entire note would be deleted upon reopening. I updated the app and this persisted. I updated to iOS 26 and now every single note and folder is gone on both my Macbook and iPad. I have tried everything on the website, peer reviews, etc. to get them back. It has been about 2 weeks now. My Premium is also gone following this update. I reached out to support 4 times and have no response yet. I guess there’s no way for you guys to resolve this issue and that’s why you’re ignoring my messages and emails, but I’m just going to switch to GoodNotes as all of my friends have been telling me since I began college. Losing everything you’ve worked so hard to do and study for right before finals during the most difficult year of college is no joke, and I can tell that support does not care at all about the customers like they used to years ago.

reviews.title: Updates are unnecessary and ruin the experience.
reviews.text: This is my 5th year using this app as a mathematician finishing grad school. For a while it was perfect simple and did what I wanted it to do! I never needed to pay for premium because if I’m honest the textures on the “premium” pens are low quality and also I have no need for 3D rainbow pens. However the latest update fixed none of the long standing glitches like images moving when exporting as pdf, writing that turns invisible until you relaunch causing overlap and illegible notes, etc. But what has been updated for no real reason whatsoever is that there is a page limit (seemingly random sometimes 5 pages sometimes 8??) that locks you out of adding more pages to your notes without a premium membership. This is ridiculous  and unnecessarily harsh. Not only that but the feature of “writing the page number to jump to that page” is so large when viewing all of your pages that you cannot format the last page since it overlaps with the format button. Something that you. NEED to do since the “Apply for new pages” button when formatting is so inconsistent it works only a 3rd of the time. Please just fix actual issues and stop slowly making this app more hostile to users.
